note: Descriptions are summaries written for this project; check each vendor's documentation for current features and licence terms. The licence type is a broad category only. Listing a tool is not an endorsement. Penetration-testing tools may only be used with written authorisation.

tools.name: Wazuh
tools.description: Open-source security platform combining agent-based log collection, file integrity monitoring, vulnerability detection and rule-based alerting.
useCases: Centralise Windows and Linux logs with an agent
Alert on rule matches such as brute force or file changes

tools.name: Elastic Security
tools.description: Security analytics on the Elastic Stack: ingest pipelines, the Elastic Common Schema (ECS), detection rules, timelines and case management. Free and paid tiers.
useCases: Search normalised logs with ECS field names
Run prebuilt and custom detection rules

tools.name: Microsoft Sentinel
tools.description: Cloud-native SIEM and SOAR in Azure that uses Kusto Query Language (KQL) for analytics rules and hunting.
useCases: Correlate Microsoft 365 and Entra ID sign-in logs

tools.name: Splunk Enterprise Security
tools.description: Commercial SIEM built on Splunk's search platform, with correlation searches, risk-based alerting and investigation workflows.
useCases: Correlation searches across many data sources

tools.name: Sysmon
tools.description: Free Microsoft Sysinternals service that logs detailed Windows activity: process creation with command lines, network connections, LSASS access, DNS queries and registry changes.
useCases: Add process and network telemetry to Windows hosts
Feed Sigma rules for process_creation and process_access
Support threat hunting without a commercial EDR

tools.name: osquery
tools.description: Exposes operating-system state (processes, users, services, network sockets) as SQL tables that can be queried across a fleet.
useCases: Ask 'which hosts run this process?' in SQL
Live triage of a suspicious host

tools.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
tools.description: Commercial endpoint detection and response with attack surface reduction rules, device isolation and advanced hunting.
useCases: Enable ASR rules such as blocking Office child processes

tools.name: Suricata
tools.description: High-performance network IDS/IPS and security monitoring engine with signature rules, protocol parsing and EVE JSON output.

tools.name: Zeek
tools.description: Network security monitor that turns traffic into structured logs (connections, DNS, HTTP, TLS, files) for analysis and hunting.
useCases: DNS and TLS metadata without decryption

tools.name: Snort 3
tools.description: Long-established open-source network intrusion prevention system using rule-based detection.

tools.name: Greenbone / OpenVAS
tools.description: Vulnerability scanner (OpenVAS) and management platform. The Greenbone Community Edition is open source.

tools.name: Tenable Nessus
tools.description: Widely used commercial vulnerability scanner with plugins for network, configuration and compliance checks.

tools.name: Trivy
tools.description: Scanner for vulnerabilities and misconfigurations in container images, file systems, code repositories and infrastructure-as-code.
useCases: Scan container images in CI pipelines

tools.name: Wireshark
tools.description: Network protocol analyser for capturing and inspecting packets field by field, with filters and protocol dissectors.
useCases: Follow TCP streams and reconstruct files
Learn protocols at the packet level

tools.name: tcpdump
tools.description: Command-line packet capture tool using libpcap and Berkeley Packet Filter expressions.
useCases: Capture traffic on servers without a GUI
Write pcap files for later analysis
Quick filtering by host, port or protocol

tools.name: Nmap
tools.description: Network discovery and port scanner with service and OS detection and a scripting engine. Use only on networks you are authorised to scan.
useCases: Asset discovery on your own network
Verify firewall rules from the outside

tools.name: MISP
tools.description: Threat intelligence sharing platform for storing, correlating and exchanging indicators and events.

tools.name: OpenCTI
tools.description: Cyber threat intelligence platform that models actors, campaigns, malware and indicators using STIX 2.1.
useCases: Build a knowledge graph of threat actors

tools.name: ATT&CK Navigator
tools.description: MITRE web tool for annotating and visualising ATT&CK matrices, for example to show detection coverage or actor techniques.

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.description: Browser-based tool from GCHQ for encoding, decoding, decompressing and analysing data with chained 'recipes'.

tools.name: Volatility 3
tools.description: Memory forensics framework for extracting processes, network connections, injected code and other artefacts from RAM images.
useCases: Find injected code in a memory image
List processes and network connections at capture time

tools.name: Autopsy
tools.description: Graphical digital forensics platform built on The Sleuth Kit for disk image analysis, timelines and keyword search.

tools.name: Plaso (log2timeline)
tools.description: Super-timeline tool that extracts timestamps from many artefact types into one sortable timeline.
useCases: Correlate file, registry and log timestamps
Reconstruct the sequence of an intrusion

tools.name: Velociraptor
tools.description: Endpoint visibility and digital forensics tool that collects artefacts and hunts across many hosts using the VQL query language.
useCases: Hunt for an IOC across the fleet
Live response on a compromised host

tools.name: TheHive
tools.description: Security incident response platform for case management, tasks and observables. A free community licence is offered alongside paid editions.

tools.name: DFIR-IRIS
tools.description: Open-source collaborative incident response platform for cases, timelines, evidence and IOCs.

tools.name: Metasploit Framework
tools.description: Penetration-testing framework with exploit modules and payloads. Authorised testing only.
useCases: Validate that a patch actually closed a vulnerability (in scope)

tools.name: Burp Suite
tools.description: Web application security testing toolkit: intercepting proxy, scanner and manual testing tools. Free Community Edition and paid editions.
useCases: Test web apps for injection and XSS (with permission)

tools.name: ZAP
tools.description: Open-source web application security scanner and intercepting proxy, suitable for automation in CI.
useCases: Baseline scans of your own web apps in CI

tools.name: BloodHound Community Edition
tools.description: Maps Active Directory and Entra ID relationships to reveal attack paths to privileged accounts. Defenders use it to find and remove those paths.
useCases: Find attack paths to Domain Admins

tools.name: Prowler
tools.description: Open-source cloud security posture tool that checks AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and Kubernetes against security best practices and compliance frameworks.
useCases: Find public storage and over-permissive IAM
Run in CI or on a schedule

tools.name: AWS Security Hub
tools.description: AWS service that aggregates security findings and runs automated checks against security standards across accounts.
useCases: Central view of findings across AWS accounts

tools.name: Microsoft Defender for Cloud
tools.description: Cloud security posture management and workload protection for Azure and multicloud environments.

workflows.title: Triage a suspicious Windows host
workflows.scenario: An alert reports Office spawning PowerShell on a workstation.

steps.action: Review the alert and the surrounding process tree in the SIEM
Query the host for running processes, autoruns and listening ports
Collect a triage package (event logs, prefetch, scheduled tasks)
Analyse a memory image for injected code and network connections
Record findings, observables and actions in the case

workflows.title: Hunt for DNS-based command and control
workflows.scenario: Threat intel reports malware using DNS TXT records for C2.

steps.action: Pull DNS logs and group queries by parent domain
Try decoding long labels (base32/base64) to confirm encoded data
Use Sysmon event 22 to find which process made the queries
Share the confirmed domain as an indicator

workflows.title: Vulnerability management cycle
workflows.scenario: A new KEV entry affects an internet-facing appliance.

steps.action: Confirm which of your hosts expose the affected service
Run an authenticated scan to confirm vulnerable versions
Check container images and dependencies for the same CVE
With authorisation, verify the fix in a test environment

workflows.title: Validate detection coverage
workflows.scenario: You want evidence that new detections fire on real attacker behaviour.

steps.action: Map current detections to ATT&CK and pick gaps
Ensure the required telemetry is being collected
In a lab, emulate the technique to generate events
Confirm the alert fires and tune false positives

workflows.title: Cloud posture review
workflows.scenario: A new cloud account needs a security baseline.

steps.action: Run best-practice checks and export findings
Enable continuous checks against a security standard
Forward cloud audit logs to the SIEM for alerting
